title: Singular barriers and quartic integrability breaking in the TTW system
summary: We study the competition between resonance-induced integrability breaking and centrifugal confinement in a symmetric quartic deformation of the classical $k=1$ Tremblay--Turbiner--Winternitz (TTW) system, $H=\frac{1}{2}\left(P_X^2+P_Y^2\right)+X^2+Y^2 +\fracγ{X^2}+\fracγ{Y^2}+κX^2Y^2.$ The inverse-square terms are the centrifugal remnants of an $SO(2)\times SO(2)$ reduction of a four-dimensional oscillator, while the $X^2Y^2$ interaction couples the reduced radial modes and connects the Smorodinsky--Winternitz and Contopoulos limits.
